scope_statement: Mechanical evidence only. The only previous-census restriction removed is the single-target requirement; TriggerAbility was not executed or traversed beyond one named edge, no compiler policy was changed, no runtime code was written, no semantics were inferred, no existing M12 record was modified and no Git write was issued.

target_classification.note: TARGET_A here is the same cleanliness test as the previous census, applied independently to each first-hop target body.

authority_chain: data/semantics/4.4.54/full_reconstruction/effect_ir_contract_v1.json :: initial_type_mapping and headless_rule (assigns kind / semantic_status / gating_risk)
src/hsr_battle_agent/game_data/behavior_compiler.py :: BehaviorCompiler._compile_operations (the only rule that decides omission versus rejection)

the_rejection_rule.condition: any other operation whose status is not in {MODELLED, REQUIRES_PACKET} or whose kind has no PRIMITIVE_BINDINGS entry
the_rejection_rule.effect: diagnostic with policy REJECT_NOT_NOOP and reason BEHAVIOR_AFFECTING_NODE_NOT_COMPILED; the operation is omitted from the compiled operation list and the whole record becomes compile_status REJECTED

RPG.GameCore.WaitAnimState.compiled_disposition_observed: never compiled; always a REJECT_NOT_NOOP diagnostic
RPG.GameCore.WaitAnimState.why: The contract assigns it gating_risk POSSIBLE_STATE_COMMIT with runtime_dependency 'explicit compiler gate', so the only omission rule cannot fire. The contract's headless_rule permits omission only once the compiler establishes the node does not gate an effect/completion/legality/target/resource/scheduler transition. No such gate exists.

RPG.GameCore.TriggerEffect.why: It is the sibling presentation operation that the current policy does omit, which is the mechanical contrast that explains why WaitAnimState differs.

RPG.GameCore.AddModifier.compiled_disposition_observed: EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE only for the selected argument sets; BOUND_UNEXECUTABLE_PACKET otherwise
special_case_policies: argument set exactly {ModifierName, LifeTime} with a fixed non-negative integral LifeTime and target alias ModifierOwnerEntity

argument set exactly {Chance, DynamicValues, InheritCaster, LifeTime, ModifierName} with fixed Chance == 1, InheritCaster == CasterSelf, a fixed positive integral LifeTime and target alias ParamEntity
argument set {ModifierName, AliveOnly} accepted only when AliveOnly is exactly False
RPG.GameCore.AddModifier.why: There is an explicit allowlist of supported argument shapes and every other shape returns EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE_ADD_MODIFIER_ARGUMENTS_UNSUPPORTED. No omission policy exists.

RPG.GameCore.Retarget with ByRandom true.only_supported_shape: source_type RPG.GameCore.Retarget, target exactly {$type, Alias=ModifierOwnerAdjoinEntity}, arguments exactly {MaxNumber, TaskList}, MaxNumber a fixed positive integer, exactly one children group with field_path TaskList
RPG.GameCore.Retarget with ByRandom true.code_comment: The selected model is deliberately limited to the source form whose collection ordering is already closed by TARGET-001: the two adjacent entities of the modifier owner, no random draw, and a static positive maximum. Broader aliases, target filters, predicates and random selection remain separate contracts.
RPG.GameCore.Retarget with ByRandom true.observed_corpus_shapes: top shapes include ByRandom=True with aliases AllDarkTeam (119), AllTeamMember (87), AllTeammate (69), AllLightTeam (61), AllEnemy (61), AllDarkTeam with MaxNumber (60); no observed shape matches the supported form
RPG.GameCore.Retarget with ByRandom true.why: ByRandom is not in the allowed argument set, the alias is outside the only supported alias, and the contract comment names random selection as a separate contract that does not exist yet.

RPG.GameCore.PredicateTaskList.compiled_disposition_observed: EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE when arguments.Predicate is a mapping
RPG.GameCore.PredicateTaskList.why: This is not an exclusion question: the operation is bound and executable-reference. No exclusion or omission policy for it exists, and none is needed.

RPG.GameCore.DispelStatus.compiled_disposition_observed: BOUND_UNEXECUTABLE_PACKET (346 occurrences corpus-wide, all with this disposition and no reference_execution_blocker)
RPG.GameCore.DispelStatus.why: It is already represented by an existing STRUCTURAL_PACKET_ONLY binding, so it is neither omitted nor payload-blocked; there is simply no executable-reference path and no exclusion policy. Its effect consumer is separately recorded as unrecovered in the existing real-skill boundary artifact.

waitanimstate_special_audit.exact_reason_it_differs: The compiler has exactly one omission rule, requiring both semantic_status PRESENTATION and gating_risk NONE. effect_ir_contract_v1.json assigns WaitAnimState gating_risk POSSIBLE_STATE_COMMIT with runtime_dependency 'explicit compiler gate', while TriggerEffect/TriggerAnimState/VCameraConfigChange/LookAt are assigned NONE with 'none for headless simulation'. So WaitAnimState fails the second half of the rule, falls through to the generic else branch, and is recorded as a REJECT_NOT_NOOP diagnostic instead of being omitted.
waitanimstate_special_audit.note: This records existing policy only. It does not decide that WaitAnimState should be omitted.

already_supported_shapes_that_exist: {Chance, DynamicValues, InheritCaster, LifeTime, ModifierName} (Chance==1, InheritCaster==CasterSelf, fixed positive LifeTime, target ParamEntity)
addmodifier_special_audit.note: No generalisation across shapes was performed; the allowlist is quoted from the code and the tests.

only_supported_retarget_shape.randomness: none (ByRandom is not an allowed argument)

random_retarget_audit.existing_rejection_rule: EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE_RETARGET_ARGUMENTS_UNSUPPORTED for any argument set other than {MaxNumber, TaskList}; EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE_RETARGET_TARGET_UNSUPPORTED for any alias other than ModifierOwnerAdjoinEntity

previous_vs_updated.mechanically_why_it_changed: The previous census inspected a body only when the root contained exactly one top-level TriggerAbility target, which covered 20 roots plus 3 roots whose own body carried a settlement operation. 290 roots name two targets and 14 name three or more, and the root body usually has no settlement operation of its own, so 642 first-hop edges lead to 634 distinct target bodies, of which 241 carry a DAMAGE_REQUEST or HEAL_REQUEST. No policy changed: the increase is entirely the removal of the single-target restriction.

top_candidates.ranking_rule: existing-authorized cleanliness: zero blockers, then runtime-input-only blockers, then fewer explicit blockers, then fewer unsupported siblings, then version provenance, then AvatarID, then SkillID, then occurrence ordinal

decision.reason: The exhaustive expansion found 241 settlement-bearing first-hop bodies instead of 7, but zero of them is clean under current policy: all 241 are compile_status REJECTED, all 241 carry a WaitAnimState REJECT_NOT_NOOP blocker, and the dominant blocker has no existing exclusion or omission rule. No repository authority authorizes omitting WaitAnimState, and no candidate reaches zero blockers.

WaitAnimState is not asserted to be safe to omit.
